title: Automated tests, upgrades and rollback
goal: Prepare an upgrade with automated tests, measured evidence and verified recovery.
prerequisites: onec.p11; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.
outcomes: Every case has an observed status.
Actual input/output and exact own source identified; unperformed stages marked NOT RUN.
Accepted original preserved; rejection and its limits explained.
sections: A release candidate contains source, version, checks, limitations and evidence. OfficialReleaseand productiondeploymentare separate approved actions. A feature branch is not a publication. Bind teaching packages to hashes, platform versions and results.

Use12 own requests30,45,15,0,60,20,25,35,40,50,55,65: total440, odd positions/customerA225, even/customerB215 and a distinct equal-named empty customer. Actual numbers may differ from referenceF1…F12; map actual references.

Check syntax, positive/negative cases, old data, repeats, cancellation and restore. P 12 changes must preserve earlierA/Pwork. Distinguish native, browser and static outcomes. Environment skips do not becomePASS, and security gates are not weakened for a green summary.

Close Enterprise, dump DT and restore into a new empty infobase. Before editing compare all12 references, customer/service/date/status/comment and durations. Record a separate path/provenance; a copy grants no extra course credit.440 alone is insufficient preservation evidence.

Preserve source package/data, restore another infobase and verify control workflows. Reverting code alone need not undo a data-schema upgrade. State acceptable recent-data loss and steps. Keep the prior instance until the new one passes admission.

Change the last65→80 only in the restored copy: expect455 with earlier identities and persistence after reopening. The original remains440. Attempt1441 and require rejection with earlier30 retained. This checks data/recovery, not authorship.

IncludeSHA, artifact hashes, caseIDs, observed logs, versions and remaining risks. Record failed experiments as problem, hypothesis, attempt, cause, decision and regression. Do not rewrite historical reports to match new outcomes. Publish learner acceptance criteria before submission rather than adding them after grading.

Bind source SHA, versions, positive/negative tests, raw protocol and restoration in the candidate package. Update customized work through compare/merge in a separate copy; full CF replacement is not a normal update. Roll back into another directory while retaining failed work and new attempts.
